summary.name: Mousio Hint
summary.one_liner: Mousio Hint is a macOS companion tool to Mousio that shows keyboard shortcut hints next to on-screen interface elements so the mouse pointer can be moved using only the keyboard.
use_cases: Moving the mouse pointer to on-screen targets without a mouse
Speeding up macOS navigation with keyboard-only control
Reducing repetitive mouse use for productivity
summary.what_it_does: Mousio Hint displays keyboard shortcut hints next to interface elements on screen, letting users jump the mouse pointer to targets using only the keyboard. It links with the main Mousio app through its settings and acts as an auxiliary positioning tool. The page says it is meant to be combined with Mousio features such as keyboard scroll wheel control, precise cursor movement, and grid navigation with focus positioning. In some apps where UI elements cannot be fully retrieved, the page suggests using Mousio directly for precise cursor control instead. It can be installed via Homebrew cask and opened with a mousiohint:// URL scheme.
notable: Shows keyboard hints on UI elements for mouse-free pointer movement
Companion to Mousio, linked through settings
Installable via Homebrew cask and opened with mousiohint:// URL scheme
caveats: Cannot function properly in the App Sandbox because it needs access to UI element locations
Some applications do not expose all UI elements, so hints may be incomplete; Mousio alone may be used instead
